definitions.explanation: The maximum speed at which vehicles are legally permitted to travel on a road. Set by traffic regulations and indicated by road signs.

examples.japanese: {制限速度|せいげんそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}って→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制限速度|せいげんそくど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時速|じそく}→時速：00128_jisoku⟧60⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧だ。
examples.english: The speed limit on this road is 60 km/h.

examples.japanese: {制限速度|せいげんそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{罰金|ばっきん}→罰金：18767_bakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}られる→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: If you drive over the speed limit, you'll be fined.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住宅街|じゅうたくがい}→住宅街：09394_juutakugai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{制限速度|せいげんそくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{時速|じそく}→時速：00128_jisoku⟧30⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げられた→引き下げる：06193_hikisageru⟧。
examples.english: The speed limit was reduced to 30 km/h in residential areas.

notes:
Essential vocabulary for driving in Japan. Japan's standard speed limits are 60 km/h on general roads and 100 km/h on expressways, though many residential and school zones have lower limits. Compound of 制限 (limit, restriction) + 速度 (speed).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {制限速度|せいげんそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to obey the speed limit
- {制限速度|せいげんそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to exceed the speed limit
- {制限速度|せいげんそくど}⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧: speed limit violation
- {制限速度|せいげんそくど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{標識|ひょうしき}→標識：15865_hyoushiki⟧: speed limit sign
- {制限速度|せいげんそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる→引き下げる：06193_hikisageru⟧: to lower the speed limit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{速度制限|そくどせいげん}→速度制限：15738_sokudoseigen⟧: speed restriction — same meaning, different word order; used more broadly
- ⟦{最高速度|さいこうそくど}→最高速度：17987_saikousokudo⟧: maximum speed — can refer to a vehicle's top speed or to the legal limit
